findings.title: Wide glyph at the last inner column can overwrite the pane border
findings.evidence: Memory-only fixture placed RGB '가' at source x=27 in 30 columns, resized the pyte screen to 28 columns, then called _draw on a 90x24 surface. The overlay emitted CUP 3;29 plus the width-2 glyph; its continuation occupied border column 30 and replaced '|'. pyte.resize removed only the clipped continuation and retained the lead, so redraw reproduced the defect.
findings.required_fix: Both curses and exact-RGB output paths must emit a cell only when the whole display-width glyph fits inside the pane inner boundary. Add a regression for a clipped wide-glyph lead after resize.
